info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Materials Science and Engineering

description.describe_ch: 電漿是物質的第四態，也是一種高能量的物質態，經常使用各種不同電源型式的電場在特定的條件下將物質提昇到電漿態，從而應用於材料的製造，尤其是薄膜型式的材料。因此新材料的開發十分仰賴電漿工程，故本課程旨在透過了解電漿行為，認識各種電漿製程，加強相關研究之前景知識，以期能獨立閱讀相關文獻資料以及相關研究之深度。
description.describe_eh: Plasma, the high energy fourth state of matters, is usually sustained by a variety of electrical power supplies and is extensively used for material synthesis, particularly in form of thin film coatings. This course provides the basic understanding of plasma behavior and the knowledge of plasma process, so as to be able to facilitate the ability for relevant literature review and the independent research of those kinds.

textBooks.tpb_book: 自編講義，提供給所有學生使用

readings.tpc_book: Principles of Plasma Discharges and Materials Processing, Michael A. Lieberman and Allan J. Lichtenberg, John Wiley & Sons, Inc. New York

電漿診斷法-蘭牟爾探針診斷法及其應用
電漿表面改質技術- 離子氮化
電漿表面改質技術- 離子佈植
電漿表面改質技術-電漿蝕刻技術
電漿薄膜工程-電漿輔助物理氣相沉積法

電漿薄膜工程- 其它電漿或離子輔助製程
電漿薄膜工程- 電漿與材料之交互作用
電漿薄膜工程- 電漿的可控變因對生長中的材料之影響

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 上課時請專注聽講，同學間私下交談將會影響其他同學的聽課學習。此外，課程中不可瀏覽手機或餐點飲食，以維護良好的學習場域。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
It's essential to maintain a focused and respectful learning environment during lectures. Private conversations between classmates can be distracting, not only for those involved but also for other students who are trying to concentrate and absorb the material being presented. Every student deserves the opportunity to engage fully in the learning experience, and interruptions can hinder that process.

Moreover, the use of mobile phones, as well as consuming food and beverages during class, can further disrupt the flow of the lecture. These distractions can take away from the overall atmosphere of focus and engagement that is crucial for effective learning. By adhering to these guidelines, we can foster a more productive environment where everyone can thrive. Let’s commit to being respectful of one another and the learning process. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, as it will contribute to a more enjoyable and effective educational experience for all. Thank you for your understanding and support.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 聽課時，請以教科書為主，以輔助教材為輔，即時掌握授課進度與內容。有任何疑問，請隨時舉手發問。或利用課後到教師研究室提問討論，以達學習之效果。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: When attending the lecture, it’s important to focus on the textbook while using supplementary teaching materials to enhance your understanding of the content being covered. This approach will help you grasp the lecture’s progress and key concepts in real time. If you have any questions or need clarification, please feel free to raise your hand during class. Alternatively, you can ask questions and engage in discussions in the teacher's laboratory after class. This interactive approach will facilitate a deeper understanding of the material and help you achieve better learning outcomes. Your active participation is encouraged and appreciated!

Unauthorized distribution, reproduction, or use of these materials outside the classroom setting not only infringes on intellectual property laws but also undermines the efforts of the creators. Your cooperation in adhering to these guidelines is essential in maintaining academic integrity and supporting the work of those who contribute to our learning. Thank you for your understanding.
